caption:
You think grace showed up after you failed. It was already there — before your fall could even take root. (Galatians 1:11 devotional)

You picture God scrambling to fix you, as if your sin caught Him off guard and grace was a hurried Plan B. But grace stood there first: at the very spot humanity fell, He promised the seed of the woman would crush the serpent's head. The cross only looked like defeat — the serpent struck His heel, the Seed crushed its head, and the war was finished right there.
